sources.note: Netsmart homepage. Company overview, product listings, 50+ year history, 500K+ users across 24K+ organizations. 28 Black Book awards in 2025.
ONC certifications page listing 8 certified products including myEvolv, myAvatar, myUnity, GEHRIMED, TheraOffice, myHealthPointe, myInsight, CarePathways. EHI export links for each product.
Primary myEvolv product page. Describes web-based behavioral health/human services EHR with clinical, financial, operational workflows for addiction treatment, autism, BH, CCBHC, IDD, foster care.
myEvolv Anywhere (CarePOV) mobile app for disconnected field documentation. iOS/Android, offline sync, appointments, assessments, electronic signatures.

Company history from 1968 roots through Creative Socio-Medics, 1992 founding, 1996 IPO, multiple PE ownership changes (Bessemer, Genstar, GI Partners/Allscripts, TA Associates). Key acquisitions timeline.
GI Partners portfolio page. Confirms current ownership by GI Partners and TA Associates. Notes 500K+ users, 25M+ individuals served.
2024 report that Netsmart owners explored sale potentially valuing company at $5B including debt, working with Goldman Sachs and William Blair.
Third-party profile of myEvolv. Web-based behavioral health EHR, configurable templates, integrated billing, medication management, treatment planning.
myEvolv overview and reviews (4.0/5 stars). Highlights behavioral health focus, treatment planning, e-prescribing, eMAR, billing, mobile access.
FindEMR profile of myEvolv. Feature list including clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, patient portal, reporting, interoperability.
Capterra reviews (~3.0/5 stars). Users cite strengths in BH-specific workflows and configurability; weaknesses in implementation, reporting, and support.
Software Advice reviews. Notes on implementation challenges, reporting limitations, and billing compliance difficulties.
TrustRadius reviews of myEvolv. Mixed feedback on system performance and customer support quality.
Black Book Research 2025 survey results. Netsmart #1 in behavioral health EHR for 9+ consecutive years based on 1,308 BH professional surveys.
KLAS Research vendor ratings for Netsmart. More mixed picture than Black Book; about two-thirds of surveyed customers would not rebuy.
Netsmart human services solutions page. Describes myEvolv ecosystem for child/family services, IDD, autism, behavioral health, foster care.
Child and family services page. Foster care management details including milestone tracking, foster parent certification workflows.
Netsmart CareConnect interoperability platform. FHIR R4 APIs, Carequality connectivity, HIE integration, Provider/Payer Patient Access APIs.
Consumer engagement solutions page. myHealthPointe patient portal, appointment scheduling, secure messaging, lab results access.
Information sharing and interoperability page. CareConnect, direct messaging, HIE connectivity, transitions of care.
CCBHC (Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinic) solutions. Quality measure reporting, outcomes data repository developed with National Council for Mental Wellbeing.
myAvatar product page for comparison. Enterprise behavioral health EHR with 20+ modules. More enterprise/hospital-focused vs myEvolv's community/human services focus.
Press release about myEvolv and myAvatar ONC certification under 2015 Edition Cures Update.
Netsmart-RethinkBH partnership announcement for integrated ABA/autism clinical documentation within myEvolv.
Case study: Arrow Child and Family Ministries using myEvolv for foster care and child services records.
Case study: Rainbows United using myEvolv for developmental disability and children's services.
Tracxn acquisition history for Netsmart. Lists key acquisitions including Sequest, HealthMEDX, DeVero, McBee, QIRT, TheraOffice, Netalytics.
Growjo company profile. Revenue and employee estimates for Netsmart Technologies.
Apple App Store listing for CarePOV (myEvolv Anywhere). Confirms mobile app for disconnected documentation with iOS support.
Market research on US behavioral health EHR market. Context for Netsmart's market position.
